name: Health & Wellbeing Hub
whoFor: Kirklees College students - mainly 16-19 year olds, plus adult and apprentice learners - needing wellbeing and employability support.
locations: Kirklees College campuses - five sites in Huddersfield and two in Dewsbury, with delivery across North and South Kirklees
eligibility: Is a Kirklees College student (including adult learners and apprentices)
At risk of falling out of education or training due to ill health, or health or wellbeing is affecting participation, progress or sustained employment
exclusions: Not a student at Kirklees College
gate: Is a Kirklees College student (including adult learners and apprentices)

activities.name: Health and Wellbeing Coaching
activities.summary: Early, holistic, work-focused support from the Student Service Hub: one-to-one coaching, on-campus health services (health checks, BACP-accredited counselling plus TAC Access online counselling, screenings), group activities and workshops, and supported inclusive work opportunities. Employment support through the on-site Job Shop with the DWP Jobs and Careers Service, including a Disability Employment Advisor.

activities.name: Embedding health and wellbeing across the college
activities.summary: Health programmes in the personal development curriculum, staff training including mental health first aid, student mental health ambassadors, and a school nurse pilot.

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
